{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuat Dome''' was one of the large spherical modules of the [[Kuat Passenger Port]]. It was responsible for dealing with flights originating from, and heading towards, the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]], including [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] itself and the [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array]].
